posts.title: 5 Signs Your Phone Needs Professional Repair
posts.excerpt: Is your phone not working like it used to? Here are the top signs that indicate it's time to visit a professional repair service.
posts.author: By Fixaro Team
posts.intro: Our smartphones have become an essential part of our daily lives. From staying connected to managing work and entertainment, we rely on our devices for almost everything. But like any piece of technology, phones can run into issues over time. Ignoring minor problems can lead to bigger, more expensive repairs down the line. Here are 5 clear signs that your phone needs professional attention.

signs.title: 1. Cracked or Damaged Screen
signs.text: A cracked screen is more than just a cosmetic issue. It can worsen over time and affect touch responsiveness. It may also expose your phone to dust and moisture, causing further internal damage.
signs.bullet: Professional screen replacement restores clarity and touch sensitivity.

signs.title: 2. Battery Drains Too Fast
signs.text: If your phone battery doesn't last even half a day or shuts down suddenly, the battery may be worn out. A new battery can bring your phone back to life.
signs.bullet: We use original batteries with full performance and safety standards.

signs.title: 3. Phone Overheats Frequently
signs.text: Some heating is normal, but if your phone gets too hot often, it could be due to software issues, a bad battery, or faulty internal components.
signs.bullet: Our experts diagnose the real cause and fix it to keep your device safe.

signs.title: 4. Charging Problems
signs.text: Loose charging port, slow charging, or not charging at all are common issues caused by dirt, wear and tear, or damaged parts.
signs.bullet: We clean or replace your charging port with precision to restore safe and fast charging.

signs.title: 5. App Crashes or Slow Performance
signs.text: If apps crash frequently or your phone lags even with simple tasks, it could be a sign of internal storage problems, software bugs, or hardware issues.
signs.bullet: We optimize and repair your hardware for smooth and lag-free performance.

posts.title: How to Protect Your Phone from Water Damage
posts.excerpt: Simple tips to protect your phone from water damage and other liquids.
posts.author: By Fixaro Team
posts.intro: Water and electronics never mix well. A small spill or a rainy commute can turn into a costly repair if you don't act quickly. These practical steps help you prevent damage and know what to do if your phone gets wet.

signs.title: 1. Keep Liquids Away
signs.text: Avoid using your phone near sinks, pools and while charging in humid bathrooms. Even a few drops can enter speaker grills and charging ports.
signs.bullet: A simple habit of keeping drinks away from your desk can save your device.

signs.title: 2. Use a Protective Case
signs.text: A sealed case and port covers add a layer of protection against splashes and light rain, especially if your phone is not officially water resistant.
signs.bullet: We can also inspect seals and ports after any liquid exposure.

signs.title: 3. Act Fast If It Gets Wet
signs.text: Power it off immediately, do not charge it, and do not use heat tools like a hair dryer. Bring it to a technician as soon as possible.
signs.bullet: Quick professional drying and diagnosis greatly improves recovery chances.

signs.title: 4. Skip the Rice Myth
signs.text: Rice does not remove moisture from internal boards and can leave starch dust inside ports. It often delays proper repair.
signs.bullet: Let experts open, clean and test the device the right way.

signs.title: 5. Get It Checked Professionally
signs.text: Corrosion can start hours after a spill even if the phone still turns on. A checkup now can prevent a dead device later.
signs.bullet: Our water-damage service includes inspection, cleaning and functional testing.

posts.title: Why Choose Professional Mobile Repair Services?
posts.excerpt: Top reasons why professional repair is better than DIY solutions.
posts.author: By Fixaro Team
posts.intro: DIY videos make repairs look easy, but one wrong screw or a cheap part can permanently damage your phone. Professional repair protects your device, data and warranty with the right tools and genuine parts.

signs.title: 1. Genuine Parts Matter
signs.text: Low-quality screens and batteries fail quickly and can even be unsafe. Certified parts keep display quality, battery life and safety at original levels.
signs.bullet: We use genuine and high-grade parts for lasting results.

signs.title: 2. Expert Diagnosis
signs.text: A lagging phone may be software, storage or hardware. Guessing the issue often leads to replacing the wrong part.
signs.bullet: Our technicians isolate the real cause before any repair starts.

signs.title: 3. The Right Tools
signs.text: Opening modern phones needs heat pads, suction tools and ESD-safe benches. Kitchen tools easily crack glass or tear flex cables.
signs.bullet: Professional tools keep the repair clean, safe and precise.

signs.title: 4. Warranty Protection
signs.text: Most DIY attempts void remaining coverage. A proper service invoice and warranty give you peace of mind after the job.
signs.bullet: We provide up to 90 days warranty on most repairs.

signs.title: 5. Faster, Safer Turnaround
signs.text: What takes hours at home is often done in 30–60 minutes in the workshop, with quality checks before handover.
signs.bullet: Book a repair and get your phone back working like new.

posts.title: 6 Signs Your Phone Battery Needs Replacement
posts.excerpt: Know the top signs that indicate your phone battery needs a replacement.
posts.author: By Fixaro Team
posts.intro: Batteries wear out with every charge cycle. If your phone feels slower, hotter or dies too soon, it may be time for a replacement rather than a new device.

signs.title: 1. Charge Does Not Last
signs.text: If you need to plug in more than twice a day with normal use, battery health has likely dropped.
signs.bullet: A genuine replacement restores all-day backup.

signs.title: 2. Sudden Shutdowns
signs.text: Phones that power off at 20% or 30% have an aging cell that cannot hold voltage under load.
signs.bullet: We test health and replace only when needed.

signs.title: 3. Unusual Heat
signs.text: A swollen or stressed battery often runs hot even when idle or while charging overnight.
signs.bullet: Stop using a swollen battery and get it replaced immediately.

signs.title: 4. Slow or Failed Charging
signs.text: If charging is very slow with the original charger, the cell or charging circuit may be failing.
signs.bullet: We check port, cable and battery before recommending parts.

signs.title: 5. Phone Feels Sluggish
signs.text: Old batteries throttle performance to stay safe, which makes apps lag and cameras slow.
signs.bullet: A new battery often makes the phone feel new again.

pages.intro: At FixPoint, we stand behind the quality of our work. This warranty policy explains what is covered, for how long, and how you can raise a claim if something goes wrong after your repair.

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: Our warranty applies to the specific repair performed and the parts used by FixPoint. It covers workmanship and genuine replacement parts fitted during the service, provided the device is used under normal conditions.

sections.title: Warranty Period
sections.text: Most repairs include up to 90 days warranty from the date of service. The exact period is mentioned on your invoice. Warranty starts on the day you collect the device and is valid only for the original customer.

sections.title: What is Covered
sections.text: The same fault returning on the repaired part or related workmanship is covered. If a part we installed fails during the warranty period, we will inspect and repair or replace it at no extra labour cost, subject to parts availability.

sections.title: What is Not Covered
sections.text: Warranty does not cover physical or liquid damage after the repair, software issues unrelated to our work, unauthorized third-party repairs, wear and tear, or faults in parts that were not serviced by us.

sections.title: How to Claim
sections.text: Bring the device along with your original invoice to the same store. Our team will inspect the issue and process a valid warranty claim as quickly as possible. A claim may be declined if the seal, screws or repair area has been tampered with.

sections.title: Need Help?
sections.text: If you have questions about your warranty, please contact our support team. We are always here to help and make your experience with FixPoint smooth and worry-free.

pages.intro: At FixPoint, customer satisfaction is our top priority. We are committed to offering transparent and fair services. Please read our refund policy carefully before using our mobile repair services.

sections.title: Eligibility for Refund
sections.text: Refunds are applicable only in specific situations where we are unable to complete the repair, the same fault reoccurs within the warranty period, or incorrect charges have been applied by our team. We review each case carefully to ensure fairness and transparency.

sections.title: Refund Timeframe
sections.text: All refund requests must be submitted within 7 days from the date of service. Requests made after this period may not be considered. Once approved, the refund will be processed within 5–7 business days using the original payment method.

sections.title: Non-Refundable Cases
sections.text: Refunds are not applicable for physical or liquid damage that occurs after the repair, change of mind after the service is completed, issues caused by unauthorized repair attempts, or software problems that are not related to our service. These conditions help us maintain the quality and reliability of our work.

sections.title: How Refunds Are Processed
sections.text: Once your refund request is approved by our team, the amount will be credited back to your original payment source. You will receive a confirmation once the refund has been successfully processed.

sections.title: Need Help?
sections.text: If you have any questions or need clarification regarding our refund policy, please feel free to contact our support team. We are always here to help and make your experience with FixPoint smooth and worry-free.

pages.intro: At FixPoint, we respect your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you book a repair or visit our website, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.text: We may collect your name, phone number, email, device details and service history when you book a repair, apply for a job, or contact support. If you visit our website, basic usage data such as pages viewed may also be collected.

sections.title: How We Use Information
sections.text: We use your information to complete repairs, share job status, process payments, send service updates, and improve our customer experience. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: Data Sharing
sections.text: We may share information with payment providers, logistics partners or legal authorities only when required to complete your service or comply with the law. Access is limited to people who need it to do their job.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.text: Our website may use cookies to remember preferences and understand how visitors use the site. You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect some site features.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.text: You may request to view, update or delete the personal information we hold about you, subject to legal and operational requirements such as invoices and warranty records.

sections.title: Need Help?
sections.text: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please contact our support team. We are always here to help and make your experience with FixPoint smooth and worry-free.

pages.intro: These terms and conditions govern your use of FixPoint services, including in-store repairs, bookings made through our website, and related support. Please read them carefully before using our services.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
sections.text: By booking a repair or using our website, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our services. We may update these terms from time to time, and the latest version will always be available on this page.

sections.title: Services
sections.text: Repair estimates, timelines and spare-part availability can vary by device model and condition. Final pricing is confirmed after diagnosis. We will inform you before proceeding if additional work or parts are required.

sections.title: User Responsibilities
sections.text: Please back up your data before handing over a device. Remove SIM cards, memory cards and passwords where possible. FixPoint is not responsible for data loss unless it is caused by proven negligence on our part.

sections.title: Payments
sections.text: Payment is due as per the invoice. Devices may be released only after full payment. Any discounts or offers apply only as stated at the time of booking and cannot be combined unless mentioned.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.text: Our liability is limited to the value of the repair paid for the specific service. We are not liable for indirect loss, delay caused by parts shortage, or issues that arise from misuse after the device is returned.

sections.title: Need Help?
sections.text: If you have questions about these terms, please contact our support team. We are always here to help and make your experience with FixPoint smooth and worry-free.

RepairFaq.subtitle: FAQS
RepairFaq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our mobile repair services, booking process, pricing, warranty and more.

items.question: What types of phones do you repair?
items.answer: We repair all major brands including iPhone, Samsung, OnePlus, Xiaomi, Vivo, Oppo, Realme and more. Whether it's a screen replacement, battery issue, charging problem or software glitch – we've got you covered.

items.question: Do you use original parts for repairs?
items.answer: Yes. We use genuine and high-quality replacement parts so your device looks and works like new after the repair.

items.question: How long does a typical repair take?
items.answer: Most common repairs such as screen and battery replacement are completed in 30–60 minutes. Complex issues may take longer, and we will inform you in advance.

items.question: Can you fix water-damaged phones?
items.answer: Yes, we handle water-damage diagnosis and repair. Bring the device as soon as possible and avoid charging it until our technicians check it.

items.question: What if my phone issue is not listed in your services?
items.answer: Contact us with your device model and issue. If it can be repaired, our team will guide you with the right solution and estimate.

items.question: How can I book a repair?
items.answer: You can book a repair through our "Book a Repair" page by filling out the form. You can also call or visit our service center directly.

items.question: Can I walk in without an appointment?
items.answer: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. Appointments are recommended during peak hours so we can serve you faster.

items.question: Do you offer pickup and drop service?
items.answer: Yes, we offer pickup and drop for eligible locations. Share your address while booking and our team will confirm the slot.

items.question: How will I know the status of my repair?
items.answer: We update you by phone or WhatsApp at every key step — from diagnosis to quality check and delivery.

items.question: How much will the repair cost?
items.answer: Repair costs depend on the type of device and issue. You can get an estimate on the repair cost page or contact our support team for a quick quote.

items.question: Do you provide a bill for the repair?
items.answer: Yes, you receive a proper invoice for every repair, including parts and service details.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept cash, UPI, debit/credit cards and other common digital payments.

items.question: Are there any extra charges for pickup and delivery?
items.answer: Pickup and delivery charges may apply based on your location. We confirm any extra fee before we proceed.

items.question: Do you provide warranty on repairs?
items.answer: Yes, we provide up to 90 days warranty on most repairs. Warranty terms may vary based on the service.

items.question: What if the issue comes back after repair?
items.answer: Bring the device back within the warranty period. We will inspect it and fix covered issues at no extra repair charge.

items.question: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied with the repair?
items.answer: If you are not satisfied, contact us and we will review the case. Refunds depend on the service type, parts used and warranty terms.

items.question: How can I extend my phone's battery life?
items.answer: Avoid overcharging, keep your software updated, reduce screen brightness and close unused apps. These simple steps can help extend battery life.

items.question: How can I protect my phone screen?
items.answer: Use a tempered glass protector and a sturdy case. Avoid keeping the phone loose with keys or coins.

items.question: What should I do if my phone gets wet?
items.answer: Power it off immediately, do not charge it, and do not use a hair dryer. Bring it to us as soon as possible for inspection.

items.question: How often should I clean my phone?
items.answer: Wipe the screen and body weekly with a soft dry cloth. Avoid liquids in charging ports and speaker grills.
